summary: Denver beat Chicago 151-145 in overtime behind Jamal Murray's 45 points and Nikola Jokić's 37-point triple-double, while Josh Giddey had 22 assists for the Bulls. Golden State held Boston to 12 fourth-quarter points to win 88-87, and Dallas survived a 16-0 Utah run and Svi Mykhailiuk's 39 points to win 116-114. Miami and Washington led wire to wire, and Bam Adebayo and Josh Hart each had a triple-double.

games.headline: Hawks open fourth with 18 straight to beat Pistons
games.story: Detroit led 85-74 after three quarters, and Atlanta scored the first 18 points of the fourth to go up 92-85. The Pistons did not score again until 4:52 remained and finished the quarter with 12 points to the Hawks' 33. Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 27 points with six threes, and Dyson Daniels had 14 rebounds, eight assists and five steals. Ausar Thompson led Detroit with 18 points and 12 rebounds, and the Pistons were without Jalen Duren.

games.headline: Adebayo's triple-double leads Heat past Thunder
games.story: Bam Adebayo had 24 points, 15 rebounds and 12 assists, and Miami led from its first basket to the end. The Heat scored 36 points in the first quarter and led by as many as 20 early in the fourth. Pelle Larsson added 21 points. Oklahoma City was without Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams, and Bennett Stirtz led the Thunder with 21 points and five threes.

games.headline: Mavericks hold off Jazz after Mykhailiuk's 39
games.story: Dallas led 114-98 with just over two minutes left, then Utah scored 16 straight points to tie it on Isaiah Collier's layup with four seconds remaining. Cooper Flagg answered with two free throws with three seconds left, and Kyle Filipowski missed a three at the buzzer. Svi Mykhailiuk scored 39 points with 10 three-pointers, including nine points in the closing run. Flagg finished with 28 points on 9-of-10 free throws, and the Mavericks led by as many as 18 in the third quarter.

games.headline: Murray scores 45 as Nuggets top Bulls in overtime
games.story: Jamal Murray scored 45 points and Nikola Jokić had 37 points, 18 rebounds and 11 assists as Denver won 151-145 in overtime. Chicago trailed 131-126 with 40 seconds left in regulation, and Josh Giddey scored the last five points, tying it with a layup with two seconds left. Murray opened overtime with a three, and the Nuggets scored the first eight points of the extra period. Giddey finished with 23 points, 14 rebounds and 22 assists, and Buddy Hield scored 33 with seven threes.

games.headline: Wizards lead wire to wire in rout of Magic
games.story: Washington never trailed, scoring 38 points in the first quarter and leading by as many as 25 in the fourth. Kyshawn George scored 24 points with six threes, and Anthony Davis added 22 on 8-of-13 shooting. Trae Young had 11 assists as the Wizards made 22 of 39 three-point attempts. Tristan da Silva led Orlando with 18 points, and the Magic were without Paolo Banchero.

games.headline: Towns scores 30 as Knicks beat Pacers
games.story: Karl-Anthony Towns scored 30 points on 9-of-14 shooting, including 4-of-4 from three, with 13 rebounds. Josh Hart had a triple-double with 10 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists, and Jalen Brunson added 22 points. New York went ahead for good at 51-49 late in the second quarter and led by 15 with 3:19 left. Pascal Siakam scored 25 for Indiana, which was without Tyrese Haliburton.

games.headline: Warriors edge Celtics 88-87 on Podziemski's late three
games.story: Brandin Podziemski's three-pointer with 2:38 left put Golden State ahead 88-86, and neither team made a field goal after it. Boston led 75-69 after three quarters and by as many as 11 late in the third, but scored only 12 points in the fourth. Jayson Tatum had 27 points and 10 rebounds and made one of two free throws with 55 seconds left, then missed a fadeaway at the buzzer. Charles Bassey added 13 points on 6-of-7 shooting with nine rebounds for the Warriors, who were without Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler III and Kristaps Porzingis.
